benefits.name: Annual Free Night Award
benefits.description: One free night award each year after card renewal, redeemable at participating Marriott Bonvoy hotels.
benefits.terms: Redeemable at hotels costing up to 85,000 Marriott Bonvoy points/night; can be combined with up to 15,000 additional points to reach higher-category properties. Deposited into the Bonvoy account 8-12 weeks after each card renewal. Resort fees may still apply.

benefits.name: Dining Credit
benefits.description: Monthly statement credit for eligible restaurant purchases worldwide.
benefits.terms: Up to $25/month ($300/year total). Unused monthly amounts do not roll over. No enrollment required.

benefits.name: Ritz-Carlton / St. Regis Property Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit applied on-property for stays of 2+ nights booked directly at participating Ritz-Carlton or St. Regis properties.
benefits.terms: Requires a minimum 2-night prepaid direct booking via marriottbonvoy.com or phone using the qualifying Luxury Credit Card Rate, paid with the card. Applies $1-for-$1 to on-property charges (dining, spa, recreation), excluding room cost, taxes, fees, and gratuities. Not annual-capped in the same way as other credits — applies per qualifying booking.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select Membership
benefits.description: Unlimited complimentary lounge visits for the cardholder and up to 2 guests at 1,200+ Priority Pass lounges worldwide.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: Cardholder plus up to 2 guests complimentary.

benefits.terms: Requires separate Priority Pass enrollment through Amex.

benefits.name: Global Entry or TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry (every 4 years) or TSA PreCheck application fee.
benefits.terms: Global Entry credit up to $120 (~4-year cycle); TSA PreCheck credit up to $85 (~4.5-5 year cycle). Only one program's fee is reimbursed. Modeled here on the Global Entry cadence; verify against the chosen program's own renewal date.

benefits.name: Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Marriott Bonvoy Platinum Elite status for as long as the card account is open, plus 25 Elite Night Credits toward status each calendar year.
benefits.terms: 25 Elite Night Credits granted per calendar year in addition to nights earned from actual stays.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $500 per trip for necessary expenses when a covered trip is delayed 6+ hours, up to 2 claims per 12-month period.
benefits.terms: Trip must be paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Baggage Insurance Plan
benefits.description: Up to $2,000 for checked baggage and a combined $3,000 for checked plus carry-on baggage on common-carrier trips paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases for 90 days against accidental damage, theft, or loss.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.description: Statement credit up to $300 per item, $1,000 per year, when a merchant won't accept an eligible return within 90 days of purchase.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty
benefits.description: Adds 1 additional year to eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Secondary coverage up to $800 per claim (max 2 claims per 12 months, $50 deductible per claim) for damage or theft of a cell phone, when the monthly wireless bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage — must exhaust other applicable insurance first. Excludes lost phones, cosmetic damage, and prepaid/rented/borrowed phones.

earningRates.terms: Restaurants worldwide and flights booked directly with airlines.
